PROGRAM LD_TEST
VAR
    Sensor1 : BOOL;
    Sensor2 : BOOL;
    sensor3 : BOOL;
    PowerOn : BOOL;
    TON_0 : TON;
    CTU_0 : CTU;
    PowerOff : BOOL;
END_VAR

(* Network 1 *)
|    Sensor1   Sensor2  PowerOn
|--+---| |---+---|/|------(S)-----|
|  | sensor3 |
|  +---| |---+

(* Network 2 *)
|               TON_0 : TON           CTU_0 : CTU
|   PowerOn  +---------------+  +----------------------+  PowerOff
|-----| |----|IN            Q|--|CU                   Q|----(R)------|
|            |PT := T#5S   ET|  |RESET := PowerOff   CV|
|            +---------------+  |PV := 10              |
|                               +----------------------+
